title: August and the Extraction
author: Lior Joubert
blurb: Yara Nakamura, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
